What is Koh Samui best known for? | Its beaches (Chaweng, Lamai, Choeng Mon), the Big Buddha, boat trips to Ang Thong Marine Park and Pig Island, the Friday walking street in Fisherman's Village and wellness resorts.
What can I do on Koh Samui for free? | Visit Big Buddha, Wat Plai Laem, Wat Khunaram, the Red Temple, Laem Sor and the Guan Yu Shrine, swim at Na Muang Waterfall 1, see Hin Ta and Hin Yai and walk the Friday Fisherman's Village market.
What are the best things to do on Koh Samui with kids? | Choeng Mon beach, Lipa Noi at high tide, a Pig Island boat trip (life jackets provided), the pool at Na Muang 1, Big Buddha and feeding the fish at Wat Plai Laem.
What can I do on Koh Samui when it rains? | Take a cooking class, book a spa, try a Muay Thai class, visit temples between showers or go to Central Samui; Pig Island boats run when the sea is safe.
Is Ang Thong worth it from Koh Samui? | Yes, for most visitors it is the best day on the island: 42 islands, the Emerald Lake and the Wua Talab viewpoint; it is closed 1 November–15 December and reopens on 16 December.
Are there ethical elephant experiences on Koh Samui? | Yes; choose a no-riding, no-bathing venue such as Samui Elephant Sanctuary, listed by World Animal Protection (about 3,000 THB a half day), and avoid any venue offering rides or shows.
How many days do I need to see Koh Samui? | Five days covers one boat trip, the temples, a waterfall, a market night and beach time; seven days adds a second boat trip and rest days.
What is there to do at night on Koh Samui? | Muay Thai fights in Chaweng every night except Thursday, beach-club fire shows, night markets in Lamai and Nathon, Fisherman's Village on Fridays and Full Moon Party boats to Koh Phangan.
Can I do a day trip from Koh Samui to Khao Sok? | Not realistically: it is 4–6 hours each way by ferry and road, so book a 2-day trip with a night in the park instead.
Do I need a scooter to see Koh Samui? | No; Grab, taxis, songthaews and tours cover the main sights, though a scooter helps in the south and west if you hold an International Driving Permit with the motorcycle category.
